dataset.title: Molecular dynamics data

dmp.description: Recently we have developed a peptide nucleic acid (PNA) and double-stranded RNA (dsRNA) triplex computational model. Implementation of molecular dynamics simulations, based on our triplex model resulted in discovery of original and effective PNA nucleobase for recognition or CG base pair in RNA. During the course of PhD research, we are planning to further develop computational techniques for the design of more selective PNA nucleobases with higher affinity and stability at physiological pH. The main goal is to create a universal set of PNA  nucleobases for recognition of any dsRNA base pair in any dsRNA sequence. This will allow to create an important tool for molecular recognition of regulatory RNA and to control its biological functions.
